label: Aristotle, Physics VIII.1, 250b18-23: Every occurrence of a world's coming to be or perishing is…
interpretation: The parenthetical necessity claim in the infinite-world cosmologists survey is isolated: generations and destructions of worlds occur with physical motion. Accompaniment does not identify substantial generation with motion in the strict sense, assert a prior motion, attribute the infinite-world cosmology to Aristotle, or establish perpetual motion. The reported cosmological conclusion and the subsequent Anaxagoras/Empedocles alternatives remain separate readings.
